## 🩺 Image URL Health Audit

Report-only. Scans every already-uploaded IMAGE URL (slots 1-11) across all 30 sheets, ONE SHEET AT A TIME (sequential, not parallel -- a fan-out version was tried and it crashed n8n Cloud from too many concurrent executions piling up memory; this is the safe, proven-stable shape used by the main sync workflow's own sheet loop). Logs any dead (404/410, confirmed after a 45s re-check to rule out CDN propagation delay) into the 'Image Health Report' tab.

**This workflow NEVER writes to IMAGE URL columns, never re-queues rows, and never triggers reclassification/repair.** It only appends findings to a report tab for a human to review. This is a deliberate design choice: the previous health-check auto-repaired dead-looking rows, which caused real data loss when combined with an unstable Drive-ordering bug (both fixed 2026-09-10). This audit is structurally incapable of repeating that failure mode.

### One-time setup
1. Create a tab named exactly `Image Health Report` in the same spreadsheet, with header row 1: checked_at | sheet_name | row_number | Product No. | slot | dead_url | status_code
2. Reattach the Google Sheets credential on both Google Sheets nodes if needed.

### To run a full audit
Just execute '🚀 Manual: Run Full Audit'. It processes all 30 sheets one at a time -- expect roughly 30-45 minutes total for the full catalog (each sheet with any dead-looking URL spends ~45s in the confirmation wait). Slower than parallel would have been, but it can't crash from resource exhaustion.

### To review results
Open the 'Image Health Report' tab. Each row is one confirmed-dead image URL. Nothing is auto-fixed -- restore affected images from Drive manually, or build a separate, explicitly-reviewed repair step later.
